# Passing tests.
sngl test passing.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

# Failing test.
! sngl test failing.sngl
stdout 'FAIL'

# --run filter.
sngl test --run=add passing.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

# --format=json output.
sngl test --format=json passing.sngl
stdout '"passed": true'

# Verbose output shows RUN lines.
sngl test --verbose passing.sngl
stdout '=== RUN'

# No test files.
! sngl test empty/

# File with no tests produces no output.
sngl test notests.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

# Parse error.
! sngl test bad.sngl

# Unknown platform.
! sngl test --platform=dos passing.sngl

-- passing.sngl --
component math {
    var x = 0
    text(value="{x}")
}

test math "add" {
    x = 2 + 3
    assert(x == 5)
}

test math "sub" {
    x = 10 - 4
    assert(x == 6)
}

test math "mul" {
    x = 3 * 7
    assert(x == 21)
}
-- failing.sngl --
component counter {
    var n = 0
    text(value="{n}")
}

test counter "should fail" {
    assert(n == 999)
}
-- notests.sngl --
component main {
}
-- bad.sngl --
not valid sngl
-- empty/.gitkeep --
